r3_swd6_llw1_5ep.interpretation: Triple combo at 5ep: best content (0.3353) but style drops to 0.7204. Negative interaction on style at 5ep.

r3_swd6_llw1_10ep.interpretation: CONTENT SOTA across all 3 rounds (cLPIPS=0.3260). 10ep rescues style (+0.0036 vs 5ep) AND huge content improvement (-0.0093 vs 5ep). vs R2 best: trades -0.0048 style for -0.0199 content.

r3_swd9_llw1_10ep.interpretation: swd_w=9 (gap fill 6-12): style 0.7259 between swd6 (0.7240) and swd12 (0.7288). Confirms monotonic swd_w -> style. Content 0.3325 between swd6 (0.3260) and swd12 (0.3459).

r3_llw05_10ep.interpretation: ll_w=0.5 (10ep): near-baseline style (-0.0010) with slight content improvement (-0.0033). ll_w=0.3 remains style-optimal at 10ep; higher ll_w trades style for content.

r3_llw2_10ep.interpretation: ll_w=2.0 (10ep): stronger content gain (-0.0152) but style drops -0.0022. Confirms ll_w as style-content trade-off knob (NOT strict improvement at 10ep, contrary to Round 2 5ep finding).

r3_spectral_15ep.interpretation: STYLE SOTA across all 3 rounds (CLIP-S=0.7311, d_idt=0.0912). 10->15ep continues to improve style (+0.0023) but content degrades (+0.0065 vs 10ep). Training length exhibits style-content trade-off past 10ep; 10ep is content sweet spot, 15ep+ is style sweet spot.
